Senses.PreferredTarget: you should serve as a ferryboat
SearchAliases: serve as a boat that carries others across
Senses.Explanation: Mazu tells Yaoshan to become a conveyance that carries others across rather than treating realization as a private stopping place. Tianyin Yuanxiu, Poshan Haiming, Miyin Zhenchuan, and Guantao Daqi actively raise and interpret the same inherited Mazu–Yaoshan instruction.
Senses.Note: The four records are active later treatments of one inherited case, not four independent origins. Mazu owns the quoted imperative; the record masters own their outer comments.
